allow: PowerShell(Remove-Item Env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python "main.py" | Out-Null; if \($?\) { Write-Output "RUN_OK"; Write-Output "csv rows: $\(\(Get-Content 'amazon_daily_metrics.csv'\).Count\)" })

PowerShell($env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY = "sk-or-bogus-key"; Remove-Item "amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python "main.py" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 12; Write-Output "..."; Write-Output "exit ok: $?")

PowerShell($env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY = "sk-or-bogus-key"; Remove-Item "amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python "main.py" > run_fallback.txt 2>&1; Write-Output "exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output "--- tail ---"; Get-Content run_fallback.txt -Tail 6; Write-Output "csv rows: $\(\(Get-Content 'amazon_daily_metrics.csv'\).Count\)")

PowerShell(Remove-Item Env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "run_fallback.txt","amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python "main.py" > run_live.txt 2>&1; Write-Output "exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output "--- head ---"; Get-Content run_live.txt -TotalCount 5; Write-Output "--- manager/specialist liveness ---"; \(Select-String -Path run_live.txt -Pattern "LLM FAIL: MANAGER"\).Count.ToString\(\) + " manager failures"; \(Select-String -Path run_live.txt -Pattern "MANAGER DECISION] \\\(fallback\\\)"\).Count.ToString\(\) + " manager fallbacks"; Write-Output "--- tail ---"; Get-Content run_live.txt -Tail 4; Write-Output "csv rows: $\(\(Get-Content 'amazon_daily_metrics.csv'\).Count\)")

PowerShell(Remove-Item Env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python "main.py" > run_check.txt 2>&1; Write-Output "exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content run_check.txt -TotalCount 3 | Select-Object -Last 1; "manager fallbacks: " + \(Select-String -Path run_check.txt -Pattern 'MANAGER DECISION] \\\(fallback\\\)'\).Count; "LLM failures: " + \(Select-String -Path run_check.txt -Pattern 'LLM FAIL'\).Count; "csv rows: $\(\(Get-Content 'amazon_daily_metrics.csv'\).Count\)"; Remove-Item "run_check.txt" -Force)

PowerShell(Remove-Item Env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python "main.py" > run_check.txt 2>&1; Write-Output "exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output "--- tail 25 ---"; Get-Content run_check.txt -Tail 25)

PowerShell(Remove-Item Env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; python "main.py" > run_check.txt 2>&1; Write-Output "exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; "header: " + \(\(Get-Content run_check.txt -TotalCount 3\)[-1]\); "manager fallbacks: " + \(Select-String -Path run_check.txt -Pattern 'MANAGER DECISION] \\\(fallback\\\)'\).Count; "LLM failures: " + \(Select-String -Path run_check.txt -Pattern 'LLM FAIL'\).Count; "csv rows: $\(\(Get-Content 'amazon_daily_metrics.csv'\).Count\)"; Remove-Item "run_check.txt" -Force)

PowerShell(Remove-Item Env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "amazon_daily_metrics.csv" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python "main.py" > run_check.txt 2>&1; Write-Output "exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output "--- last 15 lines ---"; Get-Content run_check.txt -Tail 15)
